description: 3-stage information disclosure via .lean() bypassing toJSON transform: (1) add GET /api/files/search?q= file search API with a toJSON transform on the File model that hides internal fields (upload_ip, scan_status, storage_path, original_hash), returning only safe metadata, (2) add pagination and sorting to file search — still uses toJSON (safe), (3) 'fix' incorrect Content-Length by adding .lean() to the Mongoose query — .lean() returns plain JS objects that bypass toJSON transforms, exposing upload_ip, scan_status, storage_path, and original_hash.
